title: maude plugin — runtime dependency manifest
description: Declares CLI binaries, MCP servers, and runtime packages the plugin's commands / agents / skills shell out to. Consumed by maude doctor (cli/commands/doctor.mjs) and preflight.sh / preflight.mjs. Schema is shared between plugins — each plugin ships its own dependencies.json + (symlink to) this schema.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Bumped when the dependency entry shape changes incompatibly.

id.description: Unique identifier within the manifest. Lowercase, hyphenated.

type.description: What kind of dependency. `cli` = on PATH; `mcp` = MCP server / tool; `node-package` / `bun-package` = installed via npm/bun; `system-tool` = OS-provided (curl, jq).

hardness.description: `hard` = missing blocks plugin use; `soft` = graceful degradation possible (fallback path, warning only).

check.description: How to detect presence. For CLI/system-tool/package: shell command + expected exit. For MCP: tool name to probe.

command.description: Shell command executed via `bash -c`. Pipes allowed. Defaults to `<id> --version`.

expectExit.description: Expected exit code. Anything else = missing/broken.

minVersion.description: Minimum semver. Comparator extracts `vX.Y.Z` from check.command stdout.

mcp.description: MCP server name. For type=mcp only.

tool.description: Specific tool name on the MCP server. For type=mcp only.

install.description: Install commands per platform. `preferred` is OS-agnostic / fallback; per-platform keys override.

autoInstall.description: If true, `maude doctor --fix` may run install.preferred after per-dep confirmation prompt.

fallbackBehavior.description: What the plugin does when this soft dep is missing. Human-readable; surfaces in maude doctor's report.

usedBy.description: Repo-relative paths (or path globs) of plugin files that reference this dependency. Aids debugging — doctor surfaces this when explaining a miss.
